title: CellChat Hotspot: A Targeted Approach to Cell Cell Communication Analysis With Spatial transcriptomics Validation.
abstract: Abstract. In recent years, single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA seq) has enabled the investigation of intercellular communication through Cell Cell Communication (CCC) tools such as CellChat. Despite their potential, these approaches remain challenging to interpret, particularly when global analyses generate complex interaction networks that may include biologically irrelevant signals. To address this limitation, we developed a framework termed CellChat Hotspot, designed to improve the biological interpretability of inferred communication networks. This approach integrates gene set enrichment analysis with a context driven filtering strategy, selecting both genes and cells based on their functional relevance prior to communication inference. Applied to stage II colon cancer data, CellChat Hotspot enabled the identification of condition-specific interaction patterns associated with recurrence. Non recurrent patients showed enrichment of immune related processes, whereas recurrent cases were characterized by pathways associated with invasion and metastasis. Notably, a loss of interaction in the HSPG pathway between CALB1+ and stromal cells was observed in recurrent patients, suggesting a potential disruption of cell matrix adhesion mechanisms. To verify the reliability of this finding, we applied the framework to spatial transcriptomics data, which confirmed the presence of the HSPG2 DAG1 interaction in non-recurrent tumors and its near absence in recurrent ones. Overall, this framework provides a biologically guided strategy for studying intercellular communication in complex systems such as the tumor microenvironment.

datasets_used: stage II colon cancer scRNA-seq data (摘要未命名)
llm.novelty_zh: 在CellChat类细胞通讯推断前，结合基因集富集分析与基于上下文的细胞和基因过滤策略（CellChat Hotspot），并用空间转录组验证结肠癌复发相关的HSPG2-DAG1互作。
llm.summary_zh: 该文提出CellChat Hotspot框架，在细胞通讯推断之前通过基因集富集分析和上下文过滤来筛选功能相关的基因与细胞，以提高通讯网络的可解释性。应用于II期结肠癌单细胞数据，发现复发与未复发患者间的条件特异性互作模式（如CALB1+细胞与基质细胞间HSPG通路互作缺失），并通过空间转录组数据验证HSPG2-DAG1互作的差异。该工作属于单细胞细胞通讯分析方法与肿瘤微环境研究，与虚拟细胞、扰动建模或细胞基础模型主题关系较弱。

title: Pallatom2: Navigating the De Novo Protein Universe with Atom-to-Atom Modeling
abstract: Protein binder design requires precise coordination of molecular structure, binding geometry, and experimentally measurable performance. We introduce Pallatom2, an efficient, precise Atom-to-Atom generative model that jointly models protein sequence, backbone conformation, side-chain geometry, and target-interface contacts. A unified Atom14 representation and residue-guided sparse all-atom attention enable bidirectional information exchange between residue-level and atom-level representations, coordinating global structure with local atomic detail in a compact model of just 65.9 million parameters. Its conditioning system provides fine-grained control over binder-target engagement and global and local protein conformations, supporting diverse target-specific design requirements. In silico evaluation demonstrates broad generative capability across long-chain monomers, multi-domain proteins, and homomultimers, with monomer sampling extending to 1,600 residues. In binder design, Pallatom2 achieves state-of-the-art in silico screening performance across all nine targets with cross-method benchmark data under the reported protocols. These in silico results translate into substantial experimental success: biolayer interferometry identifies 112 active designs among 210 tested candidates (53.3%), with binders obtained for all ten experimentally evaluated targets. Six targets yield picomolar-scale apparent affinities, including K_D values of 3.96 pM for SC2RBD and 33.8 pM for PD-L1, while TNF reaches 1.166 nM. Beyond de novo discovery, starting-interface-guided BCMA design preserves association kinetics despite substantial sequence divergence; partial diffusion improves TNF affinity by up to 7.57-fold; and CDR-associated interface remodeling converts an inactive de novo nanobody into binders with apparent K_D values of 4.31 and 5.93 nM. Together, these results establish Pallatom2 as a versatile model for protein design, combining efficient atomic modeling, leading in silico screening performance, and experimentally demonstrated capabilities in high-affinity binder discovery, interface transfer, affinity maturation, and recovery of inactive designs.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出 65.9M 参数的原子级（Atom14）蛋白生成模型，用残基引导的稀疏全原子注意力联合建模序列、骨架、侧链与靶点界面，并通过 210 个候选中 112 个活性设计的湿实验验证了 pM 级结合物。
llm.summary_zh: Pallatom2 是一个面向蛋白结合物设计的原子到原子生成模型，联合建模序列、主链构象、侧链几何与靶点界面接触，并支持界面迁移、亲和力成熟等条件控制。计算评估显示其在九个靶点上取得领先的 in silico 筛选表现，湿实验中 210 个候选有 112 个具有活性，多个靶点达到皮摩尔级亲和力。该工作属于蛋白设计范畴，与虚拟细胞主线为外围关系。

title: Scalable Multi-omics Diagonal Integration from Self-Mapping
abstract: Diagonal integration seeks to align single-cell multi-omics datasets in which distinct modalities, such as RNA and protein, are measured in different cells. Unlike horizontal integration, these datasets lack direct cell--cell correspondences and complete feature mappings across modalities. Leading methods for weak-linkage integration often infer anchor cells between modalities by searching for cross-modal similarities through predefined feature links, then use these anchors to guide alignment. Their required matching or anchor refinement can become computationally burdensome at atlas scale. Here, we introduce a novel self-mapping technique, a mechanism that aligns modalities by mapping each computationally decoded cross-modality omics profile prediction to its own observed inputs. We implement this strategy in SCALEMAP, a scalable, modality-agnostic method for diagonal integration. Across transcriptomic, epigenomic and proteomic benchmarks, SCALEMAP matches or outperforms leading alternatives while requiring substantially less runtime and memory. In large-scale experiments, SCALEMAP integrates more than 1.5 million multi-omic profiles in less than 5 minutes with under 20 GB peak memory, which enables rapid synthesis of massive single-cell multi-omics resources into unified biological representations.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出 self-mapping 机制用于单细胞跨模态（diagonal）整合，强调可扩展性（150 万细胞 5 分钟内完成）。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作针对单细胞多组学对角整合（不同模态在不同细胞中测量、无细胞对应关系）的问题，提出 self-mapping 技术，将每个跨模态预测映射回其自身观测输入以实现对齐，并实现为 SCALEMAP。方法在转录组、表观组和蛋白组基准上与主流方法相当或更优，同时显著降低运行时间和内存。它主要面向大规模单细胞多组学数据的快速统一表征，与虚拟细胞的扰动建模或细胞基础模型关系较弱。

title: Inferring single-cell gene expression profiles from multicellular spatial transcriptomics data with st2sc
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables the quantitative measurement of gene expression within tissue sections but is currently limited in spatial resolution, as each spot aggregates signals from multiple cells. Recovering single-cell gene expression profiles from these multicellular measurements requires two steps: explicit identification of individual cells and accurate estimation of per-gene expression. While existing methods have demonstrated the feasibility of recovering single-cell expression profiles, accurately estimating gene-level expression for individual cells remains an important challenge. To address this challenge, we propose st2sc (Spatial Transcriptomics to Single-Cell), an end-to-end framework for inferring single-cell gene profiles from multicellular ST data. st2sc introduces a novel Attention Gradient Flow Tracking (AGFT) algorithm that extracts attention maps from a Vision-Gene Transformer to identify candidate cell instances without predefined background constraints. The detected instances are then used by a set of regressors trained under a multiple-instance, multiple-target regression setting to predict precise single-cell gene expression counts. Comprehensive evaluations on synthetic and Visium-like datasets demonstrate that st2sc significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accurately segmenting cellular instances and predicting gene counts. The method can further resolve contested 2um bin in Visium HD. Application to human IPF lung showed the model can recover the subtype marker level analysis. This advancement further improves single-cell resolution analysis in spatial transcriptomics, facilitating more accurate downstream biological analyses.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出 AGFT 算法，从 Vision-Gene Transformer 的注意力梯度流中识别细胞实例，并结合多实例多目标回归，从多细胞空间转录组数据推断单细胞基因表达。
llm.summary_zh: 本文提出 st2sc 框架，用于从 Visium 等多细胞空间转录组数据中推断单细胞基因表达谱，包括细胞实例分割和逐基因表达计数预测两步。方法基于 Attention Gradient Flow Tracking 从 Vision-Gene Transformer 提取注意力图来检测候选细胞，并用多实例多目标回归器预测单细胞计数。作者在合成数据、Visium-like 数据、Visium HD 的 2um bin 及人类 IPF 肺组织上进行了评估。该工作属于空间组学超分辨率/单细胞分解方向，与虚拟细胞主题仅有间接关联。

title: Revealing the transcriptomic organization of extrasomatic interfaces using SCOUBI
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) generates substantial transcript signal outside segmented cell bodies, which is generally discarded by analysis tools. This is especially problematic for brain ST data, as neuronal mRNAs can be localized far from somata - in axons, dendrites, and synaptic compartments - and up to half of the transcripts in ST data may lie outside cell bodies. Here, we present SCOUBI, a computational framework that identifies axon-dendrite interfaces from extrasomatic RNA in ST data, revealing a hitherto overlooked layer of molecular function in neural tissues. It first partitions extrasomatic space into axon- and dendrite-enriched compartments based on known marker genes, using a neural network trained to maximize marker specificity and inter-compartment communication signals. It then defines interfaces as loci where predicted axonal and dendritic compartments converge and exhibit ligand-receptor colocalization. Applied to mouse brain, SCOUBI creates maps of axonal and dendritic compartments and their interfaces that align with known spatial patterns of neurite and synaptic distribution. It identifies transcriptomic differences between interfaces and the surrounding extrasomatic space, revealing region-specific signatures of neuronal signaling and synaptic plasticity. By comparing interface transcript enrichment with local somatic expression, SCOUBI identifies genes that preferentially localize at sites of intercellular communication rather than simply reflecting nearby cell bodies. SCOUBI reveals interface-associated transcripts beyond established synaptic genes, with molecular signatures reproducible across independent samples and imaging platforms. In summary, SCOUBI transforms a substantial and often-discarded aspect of ST data into an interpretable readout of subcellular organization and neural signaling.

llm.novelty_zh: 首次系统地利用空间转录组中细胞体外（extrasomatic）的RNA信号，通过神经网络划分轴突/树突区室并识别二者交汇处的轴突-树突界面及配体-受体共定位，揭示突触相关的亚细胞转录组结构。
llm.summary_zh: SCOUBI 是一个针对空间转录组数据中细胞体外（extrasomatic）RNA 的计算框架，利用已知标记基因和神经网络将胞外空间划分为轴突与树突富集区室，并识别二者汇聚处的轴突-树突界面。应用于小鼠脑组织，它揭示了区域特异的神经信号与突触可塑性相关转录特征，并能区分在细胞间通讯位点富集、而非仅由邻近胞体决定的基因。该工作聚焦于空间转录组的亚细胞解析分析，与虚拟细胞、扰动建模或细胞基础模型的主题关联较弱。

title: Multimodal protein representations across human brain cell types
abstract: The central nervous system (CNS) comprises diverse cell types whose molecular context shapes the roles of the proteins they express. Computational models offer a scalable way to study the roles of proteins across human brain cell types, with protein language models and interactome- or single-cell-based models capturing complementary information encoded in protein sequences and cellular network contexts. Human brain tissue is hard to access, so brain cell types make up a small fraction of the atlases single-cell models train on and of the benchmarks used for their evaluation. To capture these complementary sources of information in the CNS, we introduce SEMPER, a multimodal representation learning model that aligns protein language model representations with protein-protein interaction networks from 442 cell types of the adult human brain, giving each protein a sequence-informed representation in every cell type in which its gene is expressed. We show that SEMPER representations predict cell type-specific protein complexes and predict genes essential to the survival of dopaminergic neurons, measured in a genome-wide CRISPR screen. In zero-shot retrieval, SEMPER recovers clinically pursued drug targets for Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, Huntington's disease and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis at higher rates than cell type-specific models. To further improve target recovery, we combine SEMPER with a large language model that reasons over protein functional annotations. The combination recovers more targets, with SEMPER providing experimentally derived cellular context that complements literature-based reasoning of the large language model.
affiliations: Department of Biomedical Informatics, Harvard Medical School; Aligning Science Across Parkinson's ASAP) Collaborative Research Network; Broad Institute of MIT a

datasets_used: adult human brain single-cell atlas (442 cell types, cell type-specific protein-protein interaction networks)
genome-wide CRISPR screen in dopaminergic neurons
clinically pursued drug target annotations for PD, AD, MS, HD, ALS
llm.novelty_zh: 将蛋白语言模型表征与 442 种成人脑细胞类型的细胞类型特异性蛋白互作网络对齐，为每个蛋白在每种表达细胞类型中给出序列信息化的表征，并在零样本靶点检索上优于细胞类型特异模型。
llm.summary_zh: SEMPER 是一个多模态表征学习模型，将蛋白语言模型表征与 442 种成人人脑细胞类型的蛋白互作网络对齐，使每个蛋白在其表达的每种细胞类型中都有一个序列信息化表征。论文显示该表征可预测细胞类型特异的蛋白复合物及多巴胺能神经元存活所需基因（基于全基因组 CRISPR 筛选），并在五种神经退行性/神经系统疾病的零样本靶点检索中优于细胞类型特异模型；结合大语言模型进一步提升靶点召回。

title: Reproducibility and cross-dataset concordance of drug-induced transcriptional responses
abstract: Drug-perturbation transcriptomic resources are expanding, but the reproducibility and cross-source consistency of the responses they measure remain critical to their use. We compared six resources using independent replicates, matched-drug analyses, and response decomposition. High agreement in treated expression did not translate into equally repeatable drug-induced changes. Cross-source response concordance was generally limited, including under matched cell and treatment conditions, although some comparisons retained drug-specific information. In Tahoe, a control-expression-only baseline left substantial drug-specific variation unresolved. Measured drug main effects - the average responses across cell lines - provided information for predicting cell-specific interactions, with this relationship retained in a cross-plate validation. Exploratory analyses of structure, target, and external-response representations identified modest signals in selected pipelines. Together, these analyses characterize the reliability and transferability of current perturbation resources and identify prediction of drug main effects as a key bottleneck in the framework examined, motivating shared reference measurements and better recovery of drug-specific responses.

llm.novelty_zh: 首次系统比较六个药物扰动转录组资源的可重复性与跨来源一致性，并将药物主效应（跨细胞系平均响应）识别为预测细胞特异性药物相互作用的关键瓶颈。
llm.summary_zh: 该研究利用独立重复、匹配药物分析和响应分解，评估了六个药物扰动转录组资源的可重复性与跨来源一致性，发现处理后表达的高一致性并不等同于药物诱导变化的可重复性。研究显示测得的药物主效应可为预测细胞特异性相互作用提供信息，并在跨板验证中保持该关系，从而指出药物主效应预测是当前框架中的主要瓶颈。

title: DynamicsPLM: A Dynamics-Enriched Small Protein Language Model for Protein Variant Effect Prediction
abstract: Predicting how mutations impact protein function and stability remains a key challenge in computational biology. Current state-of-the-art protein language models (PLMs) primarily scale parameter size on sequence corpora to capture evolutionary constraints but remain blind to the explicit physical dynamics of folded proteins. Conversely, models trained strictly on physical dynamics neglect critical evolutionary sequence statistics. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing DynamicsPLM, a highly parameter-efficient 35-million-parameter model that unifies evolutionary and biophysical representation learning. Utilizing a second-stage, multi-task continual pretraining strategy on over 60,000 proteins, we enrich a foundational sequence encoder with explicit residue-level and pairwise molecular dynamics heads while preserving its original evolutionary knowledge. At inference, DynamicsPLM computes zero-shot mutation effects from sequence alone by balancing an evolutionary plausibility score against a structural dynamics disruption score. Across the massive ProteinGym benchmark and natural variants of the Tsuboyama folding stability dataset, DynamicsPLM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among all models under 100M parameters, and matches or outperforms several billion-scale sequence-based models of its size. Our findings demonstrate that explicit structural-dynamics supervision provides a parameter-efficient alternative to raw scale. Availability: All codes including data preparation scripts, training and validation recipes, and experimental configurations for LoMuS are available at: https://github.com/kabir-ai2bio-lab/DynamicsPLM.

llm.novelty_zh: 在小参数量（35M）蛋白语言模型上，通过二阶段多任务持续预训练把残基级和成对分子动力学头注入进序列编码器，并用进化合理性与结构动力学破坏分数相结合做零样本突变效应预测。
llm.summary_zh: 论文提出 DynamicsPLM，一个 35M 参数的蛋白语言模型，通过在约 6 万条蛋白上做多任务持续预训练，把分子动力学监督融入序列编码器。模型在 ProteinGym 和 Tsuboyama 稳定性数据上报告了百兆参数以下的最优结果，并与部分十亿级序列模型相当或更好。该工作属于蛋白变异效应预测，与虚拟细胞主线只有间接关系，故归为外围圈。

title: Phylospatial optimal transport for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data integration
abstract: The spatial organization of evolving cell populations in tumors influences how they progress and respond to treatment. Spatially resolved transcriptomics data may be used to examine the locations of these diverse cell states in tumor sections. However, these technologies often lack single-cell resolution and instead capture groups of cells in spatial spots, making it difficult to resolve cancer clones. In contrast, dissociated single-cell transcriptomics data are better suited for obtaining cell lineages, but do not capture the locations of the cells in the tissue. Here, we introduce SpOTr, an optimal transport approach that leverages the concordance between the evolutionary tree and the spatial distribution of cancer cells to integrate single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data from tumors. SpOTr combines a spot deconvolution model with Fused Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport, in which cells that are close in the tree are drawn to nearby spots. In simulations and in real spatial lineage tracing data, SpOTr recovered the spatial locations of clones better than methods that ignore the tree. In a human colorectal liver metastasis, SpOTr mapped copy number clones from dissociated cells to spatial spots, showing that it successfully maps the evolutionary history of tumors in space.

llm.novelty_zh: 将进化树（克隆谱系）作为先验，用 Fused Gromov-Wasserstein 最优传输结合 spot 解卷积，把单细胞克隆映射到空间 spot。
llm.summary_zh: SpOTr 是一种最优传输方法，利用肿瘤细胞进化树与空间分布的一致性，将解离单细胞转录组与空间转录组数据整合。方法结合 spot 解卷积模型与 Fused Gromov-Wasserstein 最优传输，使进化树上相近的细胞被拉向空间上相近的 spot。模拟与真实空间谱系追踪数据表明其克隆空间定位优于忽略进化树的方法。该工作聚焦肿瘤克隆的空间作图，与虚拟细胞、扰动建模或细胞基础模型关系较弱。

title: Single-cell transfer RNA sequencing reveals principles of translational regulation
abstract: Transfer RNAs (tRNAs) decode genetic instructions from messenger RNA (mRNA) into protein, yet their abundance and regulation across cell states remain largely undefined, as multimodal measures of cellular tRNAs have remained elusive. Here, we develop a massively parallel assay for single-cell translatome and RNA sequencing (sctRNA-seq), which profiles transcriptome-wide mRNA and tRNA abundance simultaneously and chart the tRNA composition of 364,841 cells. Through multimodal perturbation screening of protein-coding genes and tRNA loci, we reveal dynamics across the mRNA and tRNA transcriptomes, delineating distinct tRNA-linked modules regulated by metabolic and Pol III-mediated transcription. Further, we uncover a close correspondence between codon demand and tRNA-mediated anticodon composition during hematopoietic multilineage commitment and differentiation. Tri-modal profiling of mRNA, tRNA, and proteins from primary human T cells reveals tRNA-mediated regulation that partially explains the discordance between mRNA and protein levels, particularly for selenoproteins and transcription factors. Finally, we uncover a stress-responsive tRNA module defined by gene-internal promoter sequences. Together, our analyses resolve tRNAs as a previously undefined layer of translational control underlying cellular identity and cell-state transitions.
affiliations: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, New York, NY

llm.novelty_zh: 提出 sctRNA-seq 单细胞 tRNA 与 mRNA 同步测序方法，并结合多模态扰动筛选与 mRNA-tRNA-蛋白三模态分析，将 tRNA 确立为翻译调控层。
llm.summary_zh: 该文开发了可同时检测转录组范围 mRNA 与 tRNA 丰度的单细胞翻译组测序方法 sctRNA-seq，并在 364,841 个细胞中刻画了 tRNA 组成。通过对蛋白编码基因和 tRNA 位点的多模态扰动筛选，作者揭示了 tRNA 模块受代谢与 Pol III 转录调控，并在造血分化中发现密码子需求与反密码子组成的对应关系。三模态（mRNA、tRNA、蛋白）数据进一步表明 tRNA 调控可部分解释 mRNA 与蛋白水平的不一致。

title: Chimera: Cross-Species Single-Cell Generative Modeling of Expression Deployment Relative to Protein Conservation
abstract: A protein's sequence says what a gene could do in another species; the cells of that species say what it does there. Comparative genomics measures the first. Chimera measures the second, a gene's deployment, on the same genes and reports the difference. It aligns single-cell atlases across species in one generative model and returns, for every one-to-one ortholog, the evidence in the counts for a shared expression pattern, and {Delta}[a], the position of that evidence above or below what the protein's identity predicts. This difference is not sequence constraint under another name: across eight tissues, protein identity tracks dN/dS, whereas {Delta}[a] tracks neither. A gene therefore has two coordinates, not one, and the second can contradict the first: spermatocyte genes such as ZPBP2 keep their stage pattern on less conserved proteins, in eight held-out species, whereas conserved hepatocyte enzymes such as ALAS1 share their pattern but not their level. More broadly, genes of specialized cells sit above what their proteins predict in 23 of 24 cohorts, and approved drug targets do so more often than matched genes. Even among nearly identical proteins, where sequence can no longer tell genes apart, the count evidence still does. Nor does this rest on the model alone: independent data support the count evidence in liver and testis and, in a pre-specified test, {Delta}[a] in liver. With both coordinates, one can ask whether another species uses a gene as humans do, the premise of every animal model of a disease gene or drug target.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出基因在跨物种中的"表达部署"（Δ[a]）作为独立于蛋白序列保守性的第二维度，通过跨物种单细胞生成模型对同源基因进行量化，并与dN/dS、蛋白同一性相区分。
llm.summary_zh: Chimera 在统一的生成模型中对齐多个物种的单细胞图谱，为每个一对一直系同源基因给出共享表达模式的计数证据，以及相对于蛋白同一性预测值的偏移量 Δ[a]。该指标与蛋白序列保守性（dN/dS）基本独立，在多个组织、队列和留出物种中可区分基因的部署模式，并获得独立数据的部分支持。该工作为判断另一物种是否以与人类相同的方式使用某基因提供了框架。

title: Single-cell and spatial multi-omics mapping of human ovarian aging across young and menopausal transition
abstract: Ovarian aging is an early feature of human aging with broad consequences for women's health, yet its cellular dynamics across the menopausal transition remain unclear. We integrated single-cell transcriptomic, chromatin accessibility and spatial transcriptomic profiles across young, menopausal-transition and postmenopausal human ovaries. Granulosa cells (GCs) exhibited the most pronounced age-associated transcriptional remodelling. The menopausal transition was characterized by reduced DNA-repair activity and elevated stress-response programs in GCs, alongside broader changes in hormone-response and steroid-metabolic programs during ovarian aging. Integrated regulatory analyses implicated HEYL, a GC-enriched transcription factor, with reduced accessibility at a putative regulatory element during aging. Genetic analyses associated HEYL and its predicted upstream regulators with age at natural menopause, while spatial mapping revealed enrichment of menopause-associated genetic signals in GC-rich regions. HEYL depletion increased senescence-associated phenotypes in human granulosa-like cells and primary mouse GCs, whereas overexpression attenuated oxidative-stress-induced senescence. Perturbation of its orthologue Hey produced consistent effects in Drosophila ovaries. Together, our atlas reveals stage-associated granulosa-cell remodeling and implicates HEYL in ovarian aging.
affiliations: Department of Gynecology, Women's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine, Hangzhou, China

llm.novelty_zh: 首次在人类卵巢衰老及绝经过渡期整合单细胞转录组、染色质可及性与空间转录组图谱，并通过 HEYL 敲降/过表达实验在人源细胞、小鼠 GC 与果蝇中验证其对衰老表型的作用。
llm.summary_zh: 该研究整合了年轻、绝经过渡期和绝经后人卵巢的单细胞转录组、染色质可及性及空间转录组数据，发现颗粒细胞（GC）衰老相关转录重塑最显著，并提示转录因子 HEYL 与绝经年龄相关。通过在人源颗粒样细胞、小鼠原代 GC 及果蝇中的扰动实验，作者证明 HEYL 缺失促进衰老表型、过表达则减弱氧化应激诱导的衰老。该工作主要是生物学图谱与功能验证，与虚拟细胞建模的直接关联较弱。

title: Spindle: Scalable Indexing of Spatial-Omics Data for Fast Querying
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) has unlocked new avenues for biological discovery by jointly capturing gene expression and spatial context. ST datasets are typically stored as gene expression matrices paired with spatial coordinates, supporting queries based on expression levels at individual locations. However, characterizing how genes vary together requires representations of relationships between genes, such as covariance matrices computed over spatial neighborhoods. These gene--gene co-expression patterns capture coordinated biological variation and can reveal spatially localized gene programs. As datasets grow to atlas scale, efficiently searching for such patterns becomes a central computational bottleneck due to the combination of high dimensionality, extreme sparsity, and variability in gene expression across large numbers of spatial regions. Such searches require repeated access to second-order statistics, motivating a compact, searchable representation of spatial co-expression. We address this problem with Spindle, a platform-agnostic indexing algorithm for efficiently searching spatial gene co-expression patterns. Spindle exploits the approximate block-diagonal structure of gene--gene covariance matrices over spatial regions, in which covariances between blocks are small in magnitude, to selectively store informative components while compactly representing recurring covariance patterns. This yields a compressed yet searchable index suitable for atlas-scale spatial datasets. Across multiple real-world biological datasets (87,000--817,000 cells), Spindle indexes are 113--197 times smaller than the whole covariance matrices. A complete query, including query preprocessing, takes 2.8--28 ms on one CPU core, 5.1--16 times faster than a scan over the whole covariance matrices, and the tiles it returns recover a median of 81% of the exact near neighbors. In breast cancer, the regions retrieved by covariance search closely match the cell-type composition of the query (median cell-type composition difference 0.15, compared with 0.54 for random regions). Spindle supports both partial covariance queries and queries specified as gene lists, as well as retrieval across measurement platforms.

llm.novelty_zh: 利用空间区域内基因-基因协方差矩阵近似块对角的结构，构建紧凑且可检索的空间共表达索引，用于图谱级空间组学数据的快速查询。
llm.summary_zh: 该文提出 Spindle，一种与平台无关的索引算法，用于在图谱规模的空间转录组数据中快速检索空间基因共表达模式。它基于协方差矩阵的近似块对角结构压缩存储信息成分，索引体积约为完整协方差矩阵的 113–197 倍小，单次查询在单核 CPU 上仅需 2.8–28 ms。该工作属于空间组学数据基础设施与检索方法，与虚拟细胞、扰动建模或细胞基础模型的关联较弱。

title: Graph-guided flow matching enables biologically informed prediction at single-cell resolution
abstract: Perturb-seq enables systematic interrogation of massively parallel genetic perturbations at single-cell resolution, yet exhaustive characterization of the full perturbation space remains impractical. Here, we present Graph-guided Flow Matching (GFM), a generative framework that integrates biological knowledge graphs with latent flow matching to predict post-perturbation single-cell transcriptomes. Across multiple large-scale Perturb-seq datasets, GFM outperforms a strong linear baseline and current deep-learning models in predicting unseen single-gene perturbations, while training up to 30x faster and remaining robust with limited training data. GFM also demonstrates competitive performance in the two-gene perturbation prediction task when neither perturbed gene is observed during training. Ablation experiments show that combining flow matching with knowledge graphs enables accurate prediction of perturbation responses. Finally, GFM accurately calculates transcriptional consequences of HSP90AA1 inactivation and identifies target candidates unseen by the model in chronic myeloid leukemia. Our study establishes GFM as a biologically informed generative framework that predicts single-cell perturbation responses for prioritization of therapeutic targets.
affiliations: TRON - Translational Oncology at the University Medical Center of the Johannes Gutenberg University gGmbH, Mainz, Germany

datasets_used: Perturb-seq datasets (multiple large-scale, unnamed in abstract)
llm.novelty_zh: 将知识图谱先验与潜空间 flow matching 结合用于单细胞扰动预测，并在未见基因扰动上取得优于基线的结果，同时训练更快。
llm.summary_zh: GFM 将生物知识图谱与潜空间 flow matching 结合，用于预测扰动后的单细胞转录组。摘要称其在多个大规模 Perturb-seq 数据集上优于线性基线和现有深度学习模型，对未见单基因扰动预测更准，训练速度最高快30倍，并在两基因扰动和 CML 靶点识别案例中表现出竞争力。</searchresult>

title: HieraPTM: From PTM Site Recognition to Functional Phosphosite Prediction through Hierarchical Context and Protein Mechanics
abstract: Protein post-translational modifications (PTMs) regulate cellular signaling and protein function, making accurate site identification essential for understanding protein regulation. However, PTM site recognition and functional phosphosite prediction are largely modeled independently, limiting the transfer of large-scale recognition knowledge to functional prioritization. Here, we introduce HieraPTM-HieraFuncPhos, a cross-task hierarchical framework that separately models and conditionally integrates transferable PTM recognition representations and function-specific mechanical evidence. HieraPTM integrates local sequence patterns, protein language model representations, and three-dimensional structural information to recognize multiple PTM types. HieraFuncPhos transfers these representations through parameter-efficient adaptation and adaptively retrieves local and distal mechanical evidence conditioned on functional representations. At HSP90AA1 T36 and T115, the model reveals distinct mechanical response patterns consistent with published nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) observations, suggesting that the framework not only prioritizes functional phosphosites but also provides biophysically grounded, testable hypotheses regarding site-specific regulation. HieraPTM achieved macro-averaged AUROC and AUPRC values of 0.9237 and 0.8425 across eight PTM tasks, while maintaining competitive performance on severely imbalanced external benchmarks. HieraFuncPhos achieved an AUROC of 0.8274 and an AUPRC of 0.8188, outperforming existing comparison methods. Together, this framework connects PTM site recognition, functional prioritization, and structure-informed hypotheses regarding potential regulatory processes.

llm.novelty_zh: 将PTM位点识别的层级表征通过参数高效适配迁移到功能磷酸化位点预测，并结合结构力学证据给出特定位点调控假设（如HSP90AA1 T36/T115）。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作提出HieraPTM-HieraFuncPhos框架，融合局部序列模式、蛋白语言模型表征与三维结构信息识别多种PTM位点，并通过参数高效适配将其迁移到功能磷酸化位点优先级排序。摘要显示其在八个PTM任务和功能磷酸化位点预测上取得较高AUROC/AUPRC，并与HSP90AA1已发表的NMR观察相符。该工作属于蛋白翻译后修饰预测，与虚拟细胞、扰动建模或细胞基础模型关系较弱。

title: Spatial multi-omic profiling of non-autonomous transcriptomic and epigenomic responses to genetic perturbation
abstract: Multicellular organisms develop and maintain differentiated cell states through a combination of cell-autonomous and non-autonomous regulatory mechanisms, including signal transduction pathways mediated by ligands, receptors, and kinases. Genetic perturbation through CRISPR pooled screening is widely used to study cell-autonomous regulatory mechanisms, but the challenges of cellular-resolution in situ measurement have limited the study of non-autonomous regulatory mechanisms. We developed Perturb-Tags, a spatial multi-omic technique for pooled CRISPR screening that tags nuclei with spatial barcodes, allowing joint measurement of single-nucleus gene expression, CRISPR guide RNAs, chromatin accessibility, and spatial positions within intact tissue. Perturb-Tags achieves cellular-resolution, unbiased gene expression and multi-omic profiling, and higher sensitivity than previous spatial perturbation approaches. We used Perturb-Tags to systematically perturb ligands, receptors, and all expressed kinases in human embryoid bodies. These experiments revealed extensive non-autonomous gene expression changes after perturbation, including distance-dependent loss of signaling pathway activity upon ligand knockdown, compensatory upregulation of alternative signaling pathways, and responses to receptor and kinase knockdown that vary with cell microenvironment. We also identified changes in the spatial organization of cells with ligand and kinase knockdowns. Finally, we trained a graph neural network to model the combined effects of genetic perturbations on gene expression and chromatin accessibility across an entire tissue. Our work provides a powerful experimental and computational platform for mechanistic studies of non-autonomous regulatory mechanisms across healthy and diseased tissues.

datasets_used: Perturb-Tags spatial CRISPR screen in human embryoid bodies (in-house experimental data)
llm.novelty_zh: 提出 Perturb-Tags 空间多组学 CRISPR pooled screen 技术，在组织原位同时测量单核基因表达、gRNA、染色质可及性与空间位置，并用 GNN 建模整个组织内扰动对基因表达和染色质可及性的联合效应，首次系统揭示配体/受体/激酶扰动的非自主调控响应。
llm.summary_zh: 作者开发了 Perturb-Tags，一种通过空间条形码标记细胞核的空间多组学 pooled CRISPR 筛选方法，用于人类 embryoid body 中对配体、受体及所有表达激酶进行系统扰动。实验揭示了距离依赖的信号通路活性丧失、代偿性旁路激活以及随微环境变化的扰动响应，并观察到细胞空间组织的改变。最后，作者训练图神经网络（GNN）在整个组织范围内建模遗传扰动对基因表达与染色质可及性的联合影响。

title: Integrating Unsupervised Clustering with Transformer-Based Models for De Novo Cell Population Identification
abstract: Single-cell transcriptome sequencing has been widely applied across the life sciences. It enables accurate and robust identification of cell types in heterogeneous biological tissues through unsupervised clustering, shallow learning, and deep learning. While deep learning does not outperform shallow learning in classification performance, it streamlines cell type identification by eliminating cumbersome preprocessing procedures. However, the availability of training datasets with comprehensive cell type annotations is always limited, so new datasets inevitably contain cell populations that are not pre-defined in the training data. To address this limitation, we integrated unsupervised clustering with transformer-based models to identify cell populations unrecognized by classical methods. Specifically, we developed the Nankai GeneRank Classifier by fine-tuning the pre-trained Geneformer-V1 model, and then clustered cells based on its softmax-normalized class probability matrix (SCPM). Applied to a public colorectal cancer dataset, the new method, named SCPM-based clustering, resolved cell populations that cannot be unambiguously identified by classical methods alone and led to the discovery of novel candidate markers of colorectal cancer stem cells, demonstrating its utility.
affiliations: College of Life Sciences, Nankai University, Tianjin

datasets_used: public colorectal cancer scRNA-seq dataset (name not given in abstract)
llm.novelty_zh: 将微调后的 Geneformer-V1 输出的 softmax 归一化类别概率矩阵（SCPM）作为表征进行无监督聚类，用于识别训练集中未预定义的细胞群，并据此在结直肠癌数据中发现候选癌症干细胞标志物。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作针对单细胞注释中训练数据类别不全的问题，提出 Nankai GeneRank Classifier（微调 Geneformer-V1），并对其 softmax 类别概率矩阵 SCPM 进行无监督聚类，以发现经典方法难以明确识别的细胞群。在公开结直肠癌数据集上的应用显示该方法能解析部分细胞群，并提示了若干结直肠癌干细胞的候选标志物。整体属于基于单细胞基础模型的细胞类型识别应用型方法，方法增量和数据验证范围有限。

title: Regional Signals Matter: Rethinking Global Pooling for mRNA Foundation Models
abstract: RNA foundation models with diverse architectures have shown promise for learning representations of messenger RNA (mRNA) sequences. However, existing benchmarks commonly reduce token-level embeddings to transcript-level representations through global mean pooling before fitting a downstream probe. This aggregation does not explicitly preserve the identities of biologically distinct mRNA regions. Consequently, signals associated with short regulatory regions may be diluted, confounding assessments of representation quality with the information preserved by the readout. We introduce an architecture-agnostic, region-aware readout that separately averages embeddings within the 5$'$ untranslated region (UTR), coding sequence, and 3$'$ UTR and concatenates the resulting representations for linear probing. We reproduce mRNABench evaluations for 20 frozen models from 18 families, with a median absolute score difference of 0.0009 across 380 model--dataset--target evaluations published for 19 models, and construct a region-aware benchmark using the same models, tasks, and splits. Relative to global mean pooling, region-aware pooling increases Pearson correlation, averaged across the 20 models, by 11--25\% on translation and stability tasks, with no statistically significant decreases detected for any model on the regression tasks. On classification tasks, relative changes in the area under the precision--recall curve range from $-3\%$ to $+11\%$. Boundary randomization and displacement generally reduce performance, while dimensionality-matched and sequence-composition controls indicate that the gains are not explained solely by increased feature dimensionality, region length, or guanine--cytosine (GC) content. Learned attention pooling approaches region-aware performance only when supplied with one query per region. In silico perturbations reveal stronger sensitivity to upstream AUGs (uAUGs) and their Kozak context, while analyses of endogenous transcripts show approximately threefold greater recovery of length- and GC-adjusted uAUG-associated differences than global-mean probes. Both readouts capture codon optimality. Model rankings averaged over the regression tasks remain largely stable, while within a task models move by several places. Our region-aware benchmark therefore provides a biologically structured and complementary evaluation of mRNA foundation models, revealing regulatory information that is less accessible to linear probes after global mean pooling. The code is available at \url{https://github.com/Sanford-Labs/rnaregionpooling

llm.novelty_zh: 提出与模型架构无关的区域感知（5'UTR、CDS、3'UTR 分区平均）读出方式，替代全局均值池化，并据此构建区域感知的 mRNA 基础模型基准。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作指出 mRNA 基础模型基准中常用的全局均值池化会稀释短调控区域的信号，因此提出按 5'UTR、CDS、3'UTR 分别平均再拼接的区域感知读出方式，用于线性探针。在 20 个冻结模型上复现 mRNABench 并与全局池化对比，翻译和稳定性回归任务的 Pearson 相关性普遍提升，并通过 uAUG 与密码子最优性等分析验证其生物学可解释性。该工作属于 mRNA 表征评测方法学，与虚拟细胞核心问题只有间接关系。

title: ModBERT: a DNA modification and genetic variant-aware DNA large language model
abstract: The development of foundation models that learn a general grammar of DNA (DNA language models) has accelerated in recent years. The vast majority of DNA large language models (LLMs), such as DNABERT-2 and Nucleotide Transformer, are pretrained almost exclusively on reference genomes. They therefore cannot represent the two sources of variation most directly tied to regulatory differences between people: genetic variants and DNA methylation. Long-read sequencing (Nanopore and PacBio) now measures both from the same native DNA molecules, but no model is designed to use this joint readout. With this in mind, we developed ModBERT, a DNA language model built on a five-letter probabilistic genome representation in which each position is a distribution over A, C, G, T, 5mC (represented with M). In pretraining, these distributions encode population allele frequencies and CpG methylation levels from 242 individuals in the 1000 Genomes Long-Read Sequencing Consortium, learned with a soft-target masked language modeling objective. We further propose probabilistic fine-tuning, in which the same representation encodes one individual's genotype and methylation. A fine-tuned model can then make person-specific predictions from a single assay. Under this novel fine-tuning framework, we show that ModBERT effectively utilizes methylation information to classify peaks from functional genomic assays, including histone mark (n=11 different marks) and transcription factor binding (n=69 TFs) ChIP-seq data, outperforming ab initio trained models and ModBERT pretrained on sequences without methylation. In silico methylation perturbations yield TF sensitivities that correlate with independent methylation-aware motif models. Using an evaluation design that separates generalization to new loci from generalization to new individuals, ModBERT predicts chromatin accessibility at held-out loci in held-out individuals (AUROC 0.88). Its predicted variant effects agree with likely causal caQTLs (Spearman correlation = 0.52) but not with variants associated only through linkage, a traditionally challenging task. Overall, ModBERT establishes a framework for personal-genome language modeling, in which a model reads each individual's genetic and epigenetic sequence rather than a shared reference. This enables in silico dissection of variant and methylation effects on gene regulation and principled prioritization of candidates for experimental validation as population-scale long-read cohorts (e.g., 1KGP and Human Pangenome Reference Consortium) grow.

datasets_used: ChIP-seq transcription factor binding peaks (n=69 TFs)
llm.novelty_zh: 将个体基因型与CpG甲基化以概率化五字母（A/C/G/T/M）表示引入DNA语言模型，并提出概率微调以实现个人基因组级别的预测。
llm.summary_zh: ModBERT 是一个 DNA 语言模型，用五字母概率基因组表示同时编码群体等位基因频率和 CpG 甲基化水平，并基于 1000 Genomes 长读长数据进行软目标掩码语言模型预训练。该模型通过概率微调为单个个体的基因型和甲基化做个性化预测，在组蛋白标记与转录因子 ChIP-seq 峰分类、染色质可及性及 caQTL 效应预测上报告了结果。它属于基因组调控序列建模，与虚拟细胞主题只有间接关联。

title: Know Thy Neighbour: Benchmarking Protein Language Model Embedding-Based Annotation Reveals Anisotropy Substantially Impacts Retrieval
abstract: Functional annotation using protein language models (`pLMs') usually proceeds by transferring the function of a query's nearest neighbour in a reference database. A major drawback is that embedding-based annotation transfer has no null model, i.e. no accepted way to set a cosine-similarity threshold to control false positives. This contrasts with traditional bioinformatics methods, including sequence- and structure-based alignment tools, which rank hits with E-values derived from explicit null models. Here, we benchmark final-layer, mean-pooled embeddings from twelve models against MMseqs2 and Foldseek for remote-homology retrieval on curated datasets based on Swiss-Prot and SCOPe, fixing per-model thresholds at a 1% false-positive rate and probing the score with a ladder of synthetic decoys. On Swiss-Prot, pLMs without retrieval training recover at most 15% of remote homologs at this operating point, against 85% for MMseqs2, and for the ESM-2 and ESM-C families shuffled decoys have higher cosine similarities to their nearest database hits than real remote homologs do. These two pLM families exhibit extreme anisotropy, using fewer than 15 effective dimensions out of 640-2560, and low effective dimensionality is strongly associated with poor performance across models. Applying ZCA whitening, fit on the reference database, to the embeddings sharply raises threshold-free Top-1 superfamily retrieval, e.g. for ESM-2 650M from 59% to 88% on SCOPe, and generally improves remote homology sensitivity at a fixed false-positive rate. As correcting embedding anisotropy requires only the reference database and is compute cheap, it should be considered and tested for any pLM embedding-based annotation task.

llm.novelty_zh: 首次系统揭示蛋白语言模型（pLM）嵌入的各向异性（有效维度极低）是基于嵌入的功能注释检索失败的主因，并证明仅用参考库拟合的ZCA白化即可显著提升检索性能，同时在固定假阳性率下与MMseqs2和Foldseek进行对比。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作在 Swiss-Prot 和 SCOPe 构建的远源同源检索数据集上，以1%假阳性率为阈值，对十二种 pLM 的最终层均值池化嵌入与 MMseqs2、Foldseek 进行基准比较，并用合成诱饵序列检验相似度分数。结果显示 ESM-2 和 ESM-C 系列存在极端各向异性（有效维度不足15），低有效维度与检索性能差密切相关；对嵌入施加基于参考库的 ZCA 白化可大幅提升 Top-1 超家族检索（如 ESM-2 650M 在 SCOPe 上由59%升至88%）。该工作属于蛋白功能注释方法学，与虚拟细胞主题仅间接相关。

title: ProtCOVER: Family-Aware Conformal Prediction for Variant Effect Predictors on Unseen Protein Families
abstract: Protein language models and related variant effect predictors (VEPs) increasingly classify missense variants in proteins evolutionarily distant from those used for calibration. Split conformal prediction over variants is valid for its own target, a random variant dominated by well-studied families, but deployment needs coverage for a variant of a new family. On ProteinGym clinical substitutions with five zero-shot predictors, Mondrian conformal comes within 0.005 of that target for four predictors, yet family-weighted pathogenic coverage is only 0.823-0.873 at a 0.90 target for all five, without any shift. We present ProtCOVER, a conformal procedure that treats homology families, rather than individual variants, as the exchangeable unit. ProtCOVER (i) calibrates at the family level over label-free homology clusters, giving marginal coverage for a new family under family exchangeability; (ii) adapts to descriptor shift by calibrating conditionally on an estimated density ratio of label-free descriptors (sequence similarity, alignment depth and embedding distance; a variant reweights by the ratio instead), with finite-sample family-weighted coverage, valid as computed, whenever the true ratio is a nonnegative affine function of the estimate; and (iii) can abstain at low effective calibration support, which proved no better than random abstention. Under a shift of its descriptors, ProtCOVER's mean worse-class shortfall below the target is 0.000, against 0.010 for group-weighted and 0.029 for hierarchical conformal prediction, with larger sets (about equal at matched coverage); on orphan families and held-out embedding regions it matches group weighting (0.002 against 0.003). In evaluations following pre-registered protocols, every shift-aware method met the target on new ClinVar variants of benchmark proteins, which ESM-1b separated better; on 12,225 proteins outside the benchmark, every method fell short for pathogenic variants with either of two predictors, ProtCOVER and a variant conditioned on the descriptors the least, within the 0.01 margin of group weighting.

llm.novelty_zh: 将共形预测的可交换单位从单个变异提升为同源家族，并用基于描述符密度比的加权来应对分布偏移，以保证对新蛋白家族中致病变异的覆盖率。
llm.summary_zh: 该文针对蛋白语言模型等变异效应预测器（VEP）在进化上遥远的新蛋白家族上覆盖率不足的问题，提出 ProtCOVER：以同源家族而非单个变异作为共形预测的可交换单位，并基于标签无关描述符的密度比进行条件校准。在 ProteinGym 临床替换数据上，作者报告其在描述符偏移下的最差类别覆盖缺口更小，并在预注册协议的外部评测中检验了方法表现。该工作与虚拟细胞、扰动建模或细胞基础模型关系较弱，主要属于蛋白变异预测的不确定性校准方法学。

title: Spatial causal discovery reveals novel mechanisms of cellular senescence in human liver
abstract: The complex network of mechanisms that surround cellular senescence, such as its precise causes and effects, are not entirely understood at present. Senescence occurs when a cell permanently ceases dividing, halts apoptosis, stops performing its normal functions, and begins secreting chemicals that can induce other cells in its environment to also become senescent. Senescent cells are present in both healthy and unhealthy tissue, but their abundance is positively correlated with disease and age. A better understanding of senescence could lead to healthier aging, improved recovery from chemotherapy, or increased lifespan. This study used novel machine learning algorithms - with guaranteed properties of correctness under broad assumptions - to investigate senescence in human liver tissue by analyzing Visium spatial transcriptomics data. This produced data-driven models of the causes and effects of senescence, both locally and from nearby tissue. This report includes an assessment of whether the data meet key requirements for causal analysis, the transcripts identified by causal analyses as causes and effects of senescence marker genes, and pathway analyses of those gene sets.

datasets_used: Visium spatial transcriptomics human liver data
llm.novelty_zh: 将具有正确性保证的因果发现算法应用于 Visium 空间转录组数据，以推断人肝脏中衰老标记基因的局部及邻近组织因果来源与效应。
llm.summary_zh: 该研究使用具有理论保证的因果发现算法分析人肝脏 Visium 空间转录组数据，构建衰老的局部及邻域因果模型，并检验数据是否满足因果分析的关键前提。研究还识别了与衰老标记基因有因果关联的转录本，并对这些基因集进行通路分析。该工作主要聚焦衰老机制的因果推断，与虚拟细胞的扰动建模只有间接关联。

title: Spectrast: a multiscale spatial statistics toolkit for single-cell spatial transcriptomics
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics resolves gene expression in physical space, but the spatial statistics typically used to quantify spatial organization scale poorly to imaging-based datasets with hundreds-of-thousands of cells and thousands of genes. We recast the standard spatial-autocorrelation statistics as convolutions on a rasterized representation of the gene expression matrix and evaluate them with the fast Fourier transform. Measuring spatial statistics across multiple length scales becomes tractable for every gene using this approach, which extends naturally to differential reorganization testing between two tissue conditions.

llm.novelty_zh: 将经典空间自相关统计量重写为基因表达矩阵栅格化后的卷积，并用快速傅里叶变换（FFT）计算，使多尺度空间统计可扩展到大规模成像型空间转录组数据，并支持两种组织条件间的差异空间重组检验。
llm.summary_zh: 该文提出 Spectrast 工具包，针对成像型单细胞空间转录组中数十万细胞、数千基因带来的空间统计计算瓶颈。作者将标准空间自相关统计量转化为对栅格化表达矩阵的卷积，并借助快速傅里叶变换高效求解，从而可对每个基因在多个长度尺度上进行空间统计。该方法还可扩展到两种组织条件之间的差异空间重组检验。该工作属于空间转录组分析方法学，与虚拟细胞、扰动建模或细胞基础模型的直接关联较弱。

title: Learning gene co-regulation across cells with Multicellular Transformer
abstract: Understanding how genes coordinate across cells is central to explaining tissue function and disease, yet most existing models still take a single cell as input and therefore emphasize cell-intrinsic regulation. We present the Multicellular Transformer (MCT), a foundation model built around a different assumption: cells function together within tissues, so the appropriate unit of input is not one cell in isolation but a set of cells from the same sample. By jointly modeling multiple cells, MCT learns context-aware gene embeddings that capture gene-gene interactions across the tissue environment. Trained on a large set of tissue samples (>4200) across more than 30 tissue types, MCT recovers ligand-receptor interactions, infers cross-cell signaling programs, and reveals spatial co-localization patterns directly from scRNA-seq data. Its contextual embeddings identify disease-specific rewiring of gene neighborhoods in systemic lupus erythematosus and COVID-19 and predict population-level perturbation effects in cancer without additional training. By linking gene-level regulation to tissue-scale organization, MCT provides a scalable framework for modeling multicellular biology and enables in silico discovery of therapeutic targets and tissue-specific dependencies.

llm.novelty_zh: 将基础模型的输入单位从单细胞扩展为同一样本内的一组细胞，从而学习反映组织环境的上下文感知基因嵌入，并支持无需额外训练的群体层面扰动预测。
llm.summary_zh: Multicellular Transformer (MCT) 以同一样本中的一组细胞作为输入进行联合建模，在 4200 余个跨 30 多种组织的样本上预训练，学习上下文相关的基因嵌入。摘要称其能够直接从 scRNA-seq 中恢复配体-受体相互作用、跨细胞信号程序和空间共定位模式，并在系统性红斑狼疮和 COVID-19 中揭示疾病相关的基因邻域重连。该模型还可在无额外训练的情况下预测癌症中的群体层面扰动效应。
